Learning objective expressed by the actual interaction: Body safety, consent, feelings are free while harmful moves pause.
World: the untouched nature of the planet Raya, with tall, slender, white acoustic and telecom towers in the distance, in the shared Links universe.
Art direction: Gameplay. Show the playable board or interaction from a readable overhead or side camera. Use crisp 2D shapes and an inviting hand-painted finish. The mechanic is the hero; keep environmental detail at the edges.

A white robotic Orbi sphere companion (about 30 cm, with a coral-red left eye, a sky-blue right eye and a gentle curved smile) may float beside them. Mandatory style: a flat 2D storybook game illustration, with bold clean outlines, simple cel-shaded color areas and a restrained printed-paper texture. Readable graphic shapes seen overhead or side-on. Absolutely no 3D rendering, glossy plastic shading, photographic lighting, realistic depth of field or photorealism. This is the graphic illustration alternative to the separate 3D concept.
